cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: Dolma starts as a pile of grape leaves and filling. The dish only exists after every piece has been rolled by hand.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: In most Armenian kitchens, dolma is not made alone. It is made in groups, with each person rolling at their own pace.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: There is no definitive dolma. Grape leaves, cabbage leaves, or stuffed peppers and aubergines — all of them count.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: Dolma is almost always served with matsun. The cool dairy against the warm filling is not a suggestion. It is the point.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: After the table is cleared, the grape leaves and bowl and cloth tell you exactly what happened here.
